import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Click the 'MetaSeq all GitLab' menuitem to navigate to search results
    meta_seq_menu_item = page.get_by_role("menuitem", name="MetaSeq all GitLab")
    await meta_seq_menu_item.click()
    # Wait for the search results page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 2: On the search results page, find and click the MetaSeq project link
    # Assuming the search results list projects, look for a link with name containing 'MetaSeq'
    # Use exact=False for substring matching to be safe
    meta_seq_project_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="MetaSeq", exact=False)
    await meta_seq_project_link.click()
    # Wait for the project details page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 3: Find and click the Fork button on the project details page
    # Look for a button with role "button" and name "Fork", using exact matching
    fork_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Fork", exact=True)
    await fork_button.click()
    # Wait for the fork action to complete and page to navigate
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # No further actions needed after forking
